title: apiInputEmitPortLabels(config) is computed twice per render for apiInput nodes (once memoized, once inside _SourceHandles)
description: For an apiInput node the port label list is derived twice on every render: once in the `emitTableLabels` useMemo (line 226-229, used for the effect signature and the body label column) and again inside `_SourceHandles` via `apiInputEmitPortLabels(config)` (line 118, used to render the handles). The two call sites are documented as a shared source of truth, but they recompute the same value from the same `nodeData.config` rather than the render passing the already-memoized `emitTableLabels` down to `_SourceHandles`. Threading the memoized array (or its emptiness) into `_SourceHandles` for the apiInput branch would remove the redundant second derivation while keeping the single-source-of-truth guarantee. Pure presentational change; identical handles/labels render. Marginal (the computation is O(tables) and cheap), hence low confidence that it is worth changing.
evidence: Line 118 (_SourceHandles): const labels = apiInputEmitPortLabels(config). Line 226-229 (component body): const emitTableLabels = useMemo(() => isDeployInput ? apiInputEmitPortLabels(nodeData.config) : [], ...). Both consume the same config; _SourceHandles is invoked with the same config object (line 248).
est_reduction: ~3 lines / one redundant O(tables) pass per apiInput render
behavior_preservation: Identical rendered handles and body labels; only removes a duplicate derivation of an already-memoized value.
